user.title: HomeQuest
user.description: Add HomeQuest, the chore game for children. Then open HomeQuest in the sidebar: the setup guide asks for the children, their accounts and the parents.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HomeQuest is set up already (one per Home Assistant).
abort.already_configured: HomeQuest is set up already (one per Home Assistant).

backup_failed.title: HomeQuest did not start: backup before the update failed
backup_failed.description:
HomeQuest was updated from {from} to {to}, but it could not back up its data before changing them ({error}). Nothing was changed and HomeQuest is not running.

Free up disk space or fix the folder permissions, then restart Home Assistant. HomeQuest tries again on the next start.

migration_failed.title: HomeQuest did not start: data update failed
migration_failed.description:
HomeQuest could not update its data to the new version ({error}). The saved game was not changed and HomeQuest is not running.

Backup from before the update: {backup}. Restart Home Assistant to try again. If it fails again, install the previous version (Settings → Updates) and report the problem.

numbers_changed.title: HomeQuest: children's numbers changed after the update
numbers_changed.description:
After the update from {from} to {to}, some numbers differ from before: {changes}.

Check the children's coins and items in HomeQuest. Backup from before the update: {backup}. If everything is fine, you can ignore this message.

panel_failed.title: HomeQuest: a panel could not be opened
panel_failed.description: The HomeQuest panel {panel} could not be added to the sidebar ({error}). Restart Home Assistant. If it happens again, report the problem.

restart_required.title: HomeQuest: restart needed
restart_required.description: HomeQuest {installed} is installed, but version {running} is still running. Restart Home Assistant to finish the update (HomeQuest backs up its data first).

state.rejected: A parent sent it back, try again

not_your_list.message: This is another child's list. Children tick only their own tasks; parents and automations may tick any.

edit_in_game.message: HomeQuest tasks are changed in the game (HomeQuest → Rodič). Here you can only tick them off.

cannot_undo_approved.message: This task is done and the coins are paid. It cannot be unticked.

only_parent_can_undo.message: The task is waiting for approval. Only a parent can send it back (untick = reject).

only_parent_can_add.message: Only a parent or an automation can add a task. Children cannot give themselves tasks.

item_gone.message: This task is not in today's list any more. The list has been refreshed.

not_supported.message: HomeQuest tasks cannot be deleted or moved here. Change them in the game (HomeQuest → Rodič).

not_a_kid_list.message: Choose the To-do lists of HomeQuest children (todo.homequest_…), or none for all children.

approve.name: Approve task
approve.description: Approve a task a child finished (pays the coins).

reject.name: Reject task
reject.description: Send a finished task back to the child (no coins).

start_siege.name: Start the goblin attack
start_siege.description: Start the siege of the fortress (or a replay after a win).

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Give the children a one-off task, e.g. when the washing machine finishes.

name.name: Task
name.description: What to do, as the children will see it (1–60 characters).

reward.name: Reward
reward.description: Coins for the task (0–50). Empty = the reward set in HomeQuest → Rodič → Nastavení hry.

single.name: Only one child
single.description: Any of the chosen children may do it, but only one of them gets the coins.

skip_if_open.name: Skip if already open
skip_if_open.description: Do not add the task again while the same task for the same children is not done yet.
